steps: Create an empty private repo acme/widget-shadow (no README, license or .gitignore): on GitHub's new-repository page, or with `gh repo create acme/widget-shadow --private`.
Add acme/widget-shadow to the token's repository access, with the permissions in the token table of `ghostbranch guide`.
